problem: A particle $P$ moves along the positive $x$-axis. When the displacement of $P$ from the origin is $x\,m,$ the velocity is $v\,m/s,$ and the acceleration is $k\sqrt{x}\,{m/s}^{2},$ where $k$ is a positive constant. If $P$ has velocity $v=6\,m/s$ at the origin and the particle has velocity $v=6\sqrt{6}\,m/s$ when its displacement is $9\,m,$ find the value of $k.$

activity_context.topic_title: Determining Properties of Objects Described as Functions of Displacement
